$comment: English texts of data/regions.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the first region, Wiatrołomy, with its places, and the cards of the other regions (name, description, land), as the Combat tab shows them all; their places come in later stages. The name of a land is the same in all of its regions, as the casino groups the places of a land by it (src/engine/casino.js).

windfalls.name: Windfalls
windfalls.description: A belt of fallen trees on the edge of the wilds. Wolves, boars, deer and ravens, and deep in the thicket a wandering light and a storm-bringing Pwanetnik.

trait.name: Sacred Grove
trait.description: Rest between fights restores 5% more HP.

windfalls-edge.name: Edge of the Windfalls
windfalls-edge.description: A sparse copse by the first fallen trunks. Lone wolves and badgers, grass snakes in the long grass, and squirrels hurling pine cones from the branches.

fox-ravines.name: Fox Ravines
fox-ravines.description: Sandy ravines full of burrows. Foxes hunt here in pairs, martens leap through the trees, raccoon dogs take over the fox dens, and antlions wait at the bottom of sandy pits.

raven-hollows.name: Raven Hollows
raven-hollows.description: Upturned trees with their roots to the sky. Ravens nest on them, a tawny owl hunts at dusk, weasels dart between the roots, and a capercaillie displays in the clearing.

viper-heaps.name: Viper Deadfall
viper-heaps.description: Sun-warmed heaps of trunks. A viper basks on every stone, hornets buzz and stag beetles scrabble in the rotten logs, and a snake eagle circles above the deadfall.

boar-thicket.name: Boar Thicket
boar-thicket.description: The densest part of the Windfalls. Churned earth gives the boars away, deer slip between the trunks, a wildcat lurks in the undergrowth, and a black stork wades in the stream. Tusk marks show on the trunks higher than a man can reach.

stone-glade.name: Stone Glade
stone-glade.description: A clearing with a ring of mossy boulders, beyond which the true wilds begin. Stonelings, spiders, lynxes and packs of she-wolves led by an alpha wolf.

trait.name: Stone Circle
trait.description: The character at the front has 5% more armour.

backwaters.name: Overgrown Backwaters
backwaters.description: A valley where an old river lost its bed and spilled across the forest. Herons, beavers, catfish and crocodiles, and in the mist, drowned maidens and the water spirit.

trait.name: Reed Beds
trait.description: The character at the back of the line has 5% more dodge, hiding among the reeds.

peat-bogs.name: Peat Bogs
peat-bogs.description: Here the water has grown over with moss, and mists hang above the peat. Cranes, elk, leeches and sundews, and between the tussocks, will-o’-the-wisps, the kikimora and the bogman.

trait.name: Peat Fumes
trait.description: Poison lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

black-bog.name: Black Bog
black-bog.description: The deepest part of the Peatlands, where the water is black as tar. Alders stand here on stilts of roots, the pillars of an old temple rise from the depths, and in a thicket of creeping willow lives the devil Rokita.

trait.name: Healing Mud
trait.description: Healing from skills and potions restores 5% more HP.

black-alder-carr.name: Black Alder Carr
black-alder-carr.description: A forest of black alders on stilts of roots, knee-deep in black water. Pond turtles bask on the roots, a mink darts between the trunks, and giant dragonflies hunt above the water.

black-tarn.name: Black Tarn
black-tarn.description: A round lake of bottomless black water, ringed by a mat of moss. A pike waits in the depths, a water spider lives in silver bubbles of air, and terns cry above the water.

sunken-shrine.name: Sunken Temple
sunken-shrine.description: A pagan temple the bog took long ago. Carved pillars rise from the water, and some of them still move. The serpent of Veles circles in the depths, and the ghost of a pagan priest still performs the rites here.

quaking-bog.name: Quaking Bog
quaking-bog.description: A thin mat of moss over bottomless pools of black water. The ground trembles at every step, the lantern eyes of a Bagiennik stare out of the dark, giant ticks lurk in the moss, and at dusk a night heron hunts.

rokita-deep.name: Rokita's Abyss
rokita-deep.description: The blackest spot in the bog, in a thicket of old creeping willows. Green fire burns on the water, black goats and Bieses guard the way, and Kwobuks carry plunder to their master. Here lives the devil Rokita.

pine-dunes.name: Pine Dunes
pine-dunes.description: The first part of the Whispering Pines: dunes overgrown with heather and crooked pines. Further on the resinous forest murmurs, drifting sands bury and uncover old barrows, tar kilns smoke in the hollows, and beyond them lies a blackened burn, circled by the fiery Rarog.

trait.name: Scorching Heat
trait.description: Burn lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

heather-dunes.name: Heather Dunes
heather-dunes.description: Gentle dunes under a purple carpet of heather, with twisted pines on their crests. A sandman rises from the sand, a heather mare drifts over the heather, and at dusk nightjars skim low over the ground.

resin-pinewood.name: Resin Pinewood
resin-pinewood.description: An old pinewood where resin runs down the trunks like honey. A resin golem shuffles between the pines, barkborers gnaw at the bark, and at night tar moths flutter around the trunks.

drifting-sands.name: Drifting Sands
drifting-sands.description: A wasteland where the wind shifts the sand from place to place and uncovers old barrows. Drought husks wander the dunes, sand whirls spin, and barrow-wights come out of the barrows.

tar-pits.name: Tar Pits
tar-pits.description: The pits of the old tar burners, where wood still smoulders and birch tar bubbles. The ghosts of the tar burners guard their cauldrons, charcoal imps leap in the embers, and a Latavets circles above the smoke.

burnt-forest.name: Burnt Forest
burnt-forest.description: A forest that burned in one terrible blaze. Charred pines and ash wraiths walk between the black trunks, and spark swarms keep the last flames alive. Here nests the Rarog, the fiery falcon of legend.

silent-wilds.name: Silent Wilds
silent-wilds.description: A dense spruce wilderness where it is always night and no birds sing, and every hunter waits in hiding for whoever walks last.

trait.name: Thorns
trait.description: Bleeding lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

spruce-dusk.name: Spruce Dusk
spruce-dusk.description: The fringe of the wilds, where dusk falls at noon under the dense spruces. Needlebacks leap from the branches, smooth snakes lie in the moss, and something rustles right behind your back.

fern-thicket.name: Fern Thicket
fern-thicket.description: Waist-high ferns where you cannot see your own feet. Millipedes crawl under the fronds, fernlings rise from the earth, and mantises wait above the ferns.

forgotten-track.name: Forgotten Road
forgotten-track.description: An overgrown road through the wilds, where abandoned wagons still stand. Dogheads lie in wait for travellers, a ghostly coachman's whip cracks at night, and gadflies as big as dogs circle above the road.

mossy-dell.name: Mossy Dell
mossy-dell.description: A deep ravine with an icy stream, overgrown with moss. The torn-up roots only pretend to be dead, living darkness gathers at the bottom, and stranglers' nooses hang from the edges.

wild-den.name: Wild Den
wild-den.description: The densest heart of the wilds, a lair full of bones and antlers. Bone gnawers crack the bones, carcasses rise among the carrion, and hounds bay in the dark. Here hunts the Night Huntsman.

new-moon-depths.name: New Moon Depths
new-moon-depths.description: The deepest night of the Whispering Pines. The Moon-Eater ate the moon here, old pines rustle without wind, and out of the dark comes what should lie beneath the earth.

trait.name: Ground Frost
trait.description: Chill lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

creaking-pines.name: Creaking Pines
creaking-pines.description: Huge old pines creak and whisper, though no wind blows. Grey beards of lichen hang from the branches, something stirs in the hollows, and a murmur wraith drifts between the treetops.

rotting-logs.name: Rotting Logs
rotting-logs.description: Fallen trunks glow greenish with rot, and fungus grows inside them. Rotwoods lie like logs, puffballs smoke with spores, and earwigs crawl out of the cracks.

devils-crossroads.name: Devil's Crossroads
devils-crossroads.description: Four overgrown roads meet here in the heart of the forest. At midnight a headless one circles the crossroads, a Khokhow invites you to dance, and a Smentek sings to those who have lost their way.

plague-graves.name: Plague Graves
plague-graves.description: A forgotten graveyard from the time of the plague, hidden deep in the forest. Dead men rise from their mounds, burying beetles dig under the earth, and at midnight the bell-ringer's bell tolls.

eclipsed-glade.name: Eclipsed Glade
eclipsed-glade.description: A glade over which the moon never rises. Abominations crawl along its edge, Kowtuns roll through the grass, and a Bebok waits with a sack for whoever falls behind. Here lives the Moon-Eater.
